current_role: Assistant to the President and Deputy National Security Adviser (since May 2026)
summary: Michael Needham co-founded Heritage Action for America and ran it for about eight years before becoming Marco Rubio's Senate chief of staff in 2018. He followed Rubio to the State Department in 2025 as counselor, chief of staff and director of policy planning, and in May 2026 was reported promoted to deputy national security adviser at the White House.
